items.title: ‘Inexcusable, Vile’: AMC Chief Executive Slams Robinhood Stock Tokens
items.summary: AMC Entertainment chief executive Adam Aron criticized Robinhood Markets’ Vlad Tenev on X after the broker launched AMC stock tokens.  AMC is among more than 190 companies and ETFs that are now linked to tokens registered by a Robinhood subsidiary on an island roughly 3,000 miles from the U.S.  “This quasi-fake market you are creating on the island of Jersey sows distrust amongst the public about financial markets in general,” Aron wrote.
